_comment: Persistent record of YOLO training/fine-tune runs and which run is the current champion per architecture. Populated by model_training/finetune_depthsense.ipynb. weights always point inside runs/base_models/ -- this file never references models/finetuned/ (that folder is a manual, user-owned backup and is off-limits to notebooks/scripts).

promotion_policy._note: A candidate run must beat the current champion (same architecture) on primary_metric, must not regress secondary_metric, and must not regress speed_inference_ms by more than max_inference_ms_regression. Meeting the policy only produces a recommendation -- promotion itself is a separate, human-triggered, commented-out notebook cell.

runs.name: yolov8s_fresh
runs.notes: Seeded from existing runs/base_models/yolov8s_fresh/results.csv (final logged epoch). Only 3 epochs recorded -- appears to be an early/interrupted run, not a fully converged baseline.

runs.name: pothole_detector_yolo11s_v22
runs.notes: Seeded from existing runs/base_models/pothole_detector_yolo11s_v22/results.csv (final logged epoch, 45/150 -- training stopped early via patience). This is the current production model referenced by .env BEST_MODEL_PATH.
